CustomField.description: Deprecated and never read (#936). A template section repeater has no Select button, so there is nothing for this flag to act on; selecting a record inside the edit popup and returning is a Flow repeater property (editModalReturnOnSelect). Left in place because a packaged field cannot be removed. Leave it unchecked.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Deprecated and has no effect; leave it unchecked. Closing an edit popup on Select is a Flow repeater setting, not a template section one.
CustomField.label: Return on Select
